code: Behind the scenes, `calculate_emf_doses()` calls various source-specific dose functions, which calculate the individual contributions of different sources (e.g. mobile phone calls). These functions may be used individually.  ### Stochastic dose calculation  `calculate_emf_doses_stochastic()` gives the uncertainty of the doses. It calculates the doses of each row `n` times (default: 1000), each time with parameters, SAR values and input values drawn from their distributions (see [Uncertainty in the stochastic model](#uncertainty-in-the-stochastic-model)), and summarises the doses of all draws. It takes the same arguments as `calculate_emf_doses()`, including `sar_file`. Give a `seed` for reproducible results: the same seed and arguments give the same draws.  ```{r} # Calculate example doses with their uncertainty calculate_emf_doses_stochastic(example_data, tissue = "brain", n = 1000, seed = 1) sample_id row       dose deterministic  mean    sd  q2.5   q50 q97.5      TEST1   1  call_dose          73.2  75.4  44.1  22.3  66.0 186.1      TEST1   1  data_dose         203.1 207.2  79.6  99.6 192.1 404.9      ...
